title: Solutions Architect
summary: A solutions architect turns a business need into a complete technical design, choosing the systems, integrations and cloud services to use. It is a senior role that leads design for delivery teams and often supports pre-sales proposals for clients.
dailyDuties: Run discovery with business teams and capture functional and non-functional needs
Design end-to-end solutions on a major cloud with clear trade-offs
Define APIs, service boundaries and integration patterns
Plan migration and modernisation of existing systems
Shape proposals, estimates and RFP responses
Present designs in architecture reviews and record decisions
